notices.description: The Agencys current SAN Storage Brocade Switches are no longer under maintenance support, meaning the vendor will not provide software updates, security patches, technical support, or hardware replacements for this model. This situation poses a significant risk and has the potential to impact our business operations, as 100% of the Agencys production environment relies on these Brocade switches. To mitigate this risk, it is crucial for DSS ITS to secure break-fix support to ensure that our mission-critical enterprise applications remain operational. To maintain confidence in our ability to perform quick repairs and provide tracking reports and uptime for production we need this procurement as soon as possible.
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Abrahams Consulting LLC a $67,494 one-year contract for support of its SAN storage switches, using a noncompetitive small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business.

notices.short_title: 82627B0022-BEDC-NR-107: Structural improvements to the North River WRRF
notices.description: The North River WRRF was originally constructed in 1986, was constructed above the Hudson River with a majority of the structure supported by steel caissons driven into the river soil. Numerous structural elements within the North River WRRF have shown signs of aging and significant degradation. The facility requires repair and upgrades to improve its compliance with DEPs standard operating procedures and to continue to provide reliable wastewater treatment operations in accordance with wastewater treatment regulations. Contract NR-107 will implement structural improvements to the North River WRRF. Contract NR-107 comprises four main project elements: steel caisson protection, sludge barge loading dock fender replacement, underdeck repair and improvements, and ice breaker reconstruction. This Competitive Sealed Bid (RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal Navigator at https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the…
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking sealed bids from contractors through Dec. 9, 2026, for structural repairs to the aging North River wastewater treatment plant, including steel caisson protection, dock fender replacement, underdeck repairs and ice breaker reconstruction.

notices.description:
Pursuant to Section 1-02(h)(1)(ii) of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules, the City Chief Procurement Officer (CCPO) ratified a Minor Rules Violation request submitted by the New York City Department of Probation (DOP) on October 15, 2026, concerning a Negotiated Acquisition Extension (NAE) with the Center for Alternative Sentencing and Employment Services, Inc. (CASES), EPIN 78125N0002001, for the provision of Pathways to Excellence, Achievement, and Knowledge (PEAK) Program services.

The contract covers the period October 1, 2024, through September 30, 2025, in the amount of $989,807.94.

The violation concerns PPB Rule § 2-11, as the required public notice and comment process was conducted after commencement of the contract term. The notice was published in the City Record on July 7, 2025, with a public hearing held on July 17, 2025.

DOP determined that the procedural violation did not have a significant adverse impact on the procurement process or its outcome. notices.plain: The Department of Probation had a late public notice for a $989,807.94 extension with the Center for Alternative Sentencing and Employment Services, Inc. for its PEAK Program, which the City Chief Procurement Officer ratified on Oct. 22, 2026.
